newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE NAME TWO NEWCOMERS IN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE NAME TWO NEWCOMERS IN SQUAD.

text.p: Injury-hit France named two newcomers on Saturday in a squad of 21 to prepare for their Five Nations championship match at home to Wales in two weeks' time.
Prop Pierre Triep and third row forward Olivier Magne have been drafted in as replacements for Franck Tournaire, suspended for one match, and injured flanker Philippe Benetton.
Team manager Jo Maso said: "We still have a lot of injuries in the squad and these two players have shown excellent things since the start of the season."
Scrum-half Guy Accoceberry has been recalled to the squad following injury to Fabien Galthie during France's victory over Ireland in Dublin two weeks ago.

Coach Jean-Claude Skrela said: "The big challenge, for us, is the match against the English (at Twickenham on March 1). But we also wanted to show our very best to our Welsh friends. There's no question of us underestimating this match."
France, who were not playing on Saturday, are expected to name their team on February 12.

Forwards - Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), Christian Califano, Richard Castel, Marc Dal Mazo, Marc de Rougemont, Jean-Louis Jordana, Olivier Magne, Olivier Merle, Hugues Miorin, Fabien Pelous, Pierre Triep.
Backs - Guy Accoceberry, Philippe Carbonneau, Thomas Castaignede, Richard Dourthe, Stephane Glas, Christophe Lamaison, Emile N'Tamack, Alain Penaud, Jean-Luc Sadourny, David Venditti.
